instruction: Add a bond port with LACP
output: ovs-vsctl add-bond br0 bond0 eth0 eth1 lacp=active

instruction: Set QoS on port eth0 to rate limit
output: ovs-vsctl set port eth0 qos=@qos -- --id=@qos create qos type=linux-htb other-config:max-rate=100000000

instruction: Display interface statistics for eth0
Assign a specific OpenFlow port number
List all QoS policies
List all queue configurations
Create a QoS queue with min-rate
Clear the controller of br0 temporarily
Set the OF controller list
Check if br0 has the correct datapath type
Set the datapath type to netdev
Add a VXLAN tunnel port
output: ovs-vsctl add-port br0 vxlan0 -- set interface vxlan0 type=vxlan options:remote_ip=10.0.0.3 options:key=100

instruction: List external_ids on bridge br0
Set external_ids for the bridge
Destroy a QoS configuration
Remove all ports from bridge br0
output: ovs-vsctl list-ports br0 | xargs -I {} ovs-vsctl del-port br0 {}

instruction: Add a patch port between two bridges
output: ovs-vsctl add-port br0 patch0 -- set interface patch0 type=patch options:peer=patch1

instruction: Add the peer patch port on br1
output: ovs-vsctl add-port br1 patch1 -- set interface patch1 type=patch options:peer=patch0

instruction: Set interface eth0 to up
Get the MAC address of eth0
Emulate an OVS bridge with netdev datapath
output: ovs-vsctl add-br br0 -- set bridge br0 datapath_type=netdev

instruction: Create a bridge with a specific datapath ID
output: ovs-vsctl add-br br0 -- set bridge br0 datapath_id=0000000000000001
